verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants search and retrieve designs and pages. It can also export designs to PNG/JPG, which an agent could use as screenshots, and it gives access to brand kits. Nothing in the evidence shows design-to-code context such as frames, variables/tokens or component-to-code mappings for implementing a design. missing for 10: frame/layer structure retrieval, design variables/tokens, component mappings to code, documented design-to-code agent workflow, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can pull real design context — frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings — through an MCP server or API to implement the design

citations.quote: The Canva MCP server enables AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Canva's design capabilities.
Search and retrieve designs, pages, and folders from your design library
Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, and so on)
